title: Windows 7 Startup
blurb: Sleeker and considerably more confident than XP's chime, the Windows 7 boot flourish is the anthem of computing's most beloved operating system. Released in 2009 to clean up after Vista, Windows 7 earned a loyalty Microsoft has never quite recovered since, and this four-note swell is the sound people mean when they say they miss it. It arrives when the machine is genuinely ready rather than merely showing you a desktop. Play it to summon anybody who still resents every version that followed, which is a surprisingly large number of people.
origin: The boot sound from Microsoft Windows 7 (2009).
